model.scope_statement: Canonical JSON SSOT for workflow/control-plane diagrams covering local hooks, verify fast runtime path, CI jobs, logging/evidence, and self-hosting diagram subsystem.
model.determinism_contract: Only this JSON is manually edited. Generated diagram views are stale-checked and must not be edited manually.
freeze_rules: Workflow changes without SSOT update are P0 drift.
Promotion to APPROVED requires alignment and stale-check implementation.

views.label: Full control plane
views.purpose: Canonical full process graph view covering local hooks, verify fast runtime path, self-hosting diagram subsystem, non-blocking backlog paths, CI jobs, and evidence logging.

views.label: Verify + evidence path
views.purpose: Focused path for governance/verify execution, claim=evidence guard, control docs + diagram stale-checks, backlog reports, and verify run logging.

views.label: Verify + test flow
views.purpose: Focused local verify runtime path from pre-commit into blocking docs/test checks and verify run logging, excluding CI fanout and backlog branches.

views.label: Logging + evidence claims
views.purpose: Focused claim=evidence and evidence logging path around capability audit, preflight discovery, batch claim verification, traceability/session validators, and verify run logging.

views.label: Docs generation + stale-check
views.purpose: Focused control-doc and diagram generation path, stale-check gates, docs-quality sequence, and non-blocking backlog reports.

views.label: Hooks + CI enforcement
views.purpose: Entry-point and enforcement fanout view from local pre-commit and CI jobs into shared docs lint and code-audit check paths.
